_readme: One caption list per Buffer service. The script picks variant (day number mod list length) so posts rotate. Placeholders: {practice} {why} {area} {pillar} {link}. {pillar} is the day's pillar in capitals (CONFIDENCE, CHARACTER, RESPECT). {link} is APP_LINK, or empty. No emojis, Oxford comma, never the words confidence, character, or respect, and never start with Today. A key ending in _area (for example instagram_area) replaces that service's caption on the Focus area posts.
